newsitem.title: CHINA: Chlor Alkali sets low 1997 target.
newsitem.headline: Chlor Alkali sets low 1997 target.

text.p: Shanghai Chlor Alkali Chemical Co has set itself a low profit target of 224 million yuan in 1997 against 234.775 million yuan in 1996 based on international accounting standards, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Thursday.
The target was approved by shareholders at a recent meeting, the newspaper said but did not elaborate.
A company spokesman said the low expectation was mainly due to rising prices of raw materials.

The company has also been hit by falling prices of its major product, polyvinyl chloride (PVC), since the start of last year, with its 1996 net profit marginally up from 1995's 231.51 million yuan, Shanghai brokers said.

The spokesman said the company planned to complete two key projects this year -- a PVC production plant and a caustic soda plant, each with an annual capacity of 100,000 tonnes -- which will become new sources of revenue next year.
